subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Once exact-head checks pass, should ClawSweeper adopt the centralized durable drainer, fail-closed active-ledger ceiling, and sealed requeue authority as its production repair contract?
rationale: The patch mechanics are reviewable, but privileged cross-workflow authority, overload recovery, and centralized queue liveness are production policy choices that require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Adopt after exact-head checks
options.body: Merge after the live head is fully green, accepting the centralized queue and hard-overflow behavior as the supported operating model.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Separate queue durability, staged-proof bounds, and requeue authorization into independently deployable changes.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Do not land this draft if maintainers do not want centralized repair liveness or fail-closed overload behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Merge after the live head is fully green, accepting the centralized queue and hard-overflow behavior as the supported operating model.
